description: Create and manage a deployed agent's own skills. A custom skill (key cs-...) is standing instructions the agent follows, for example a tone or an approval policy. A scheduled task (key cs-cron-...) is a prompt the agent runs by itself on a cron schedule, for example a weekly report. Actions: upsert creates or updates one (a bare key such as "weekly-report" updates the agent's own entry of that name when there is one, and otherwise gets its prefix from kind or interval; the result gives the final key); rename changes the key of one you created; delete removes one you created together with its history (needs confirm: true); history shows the current text in full and lists earlier versions, the template default and ready-made templates (key "cs-my-custom-strategy" or "cs-cron-my-scheduled-task" gives starter templates); revert restores the template default or an earlier version (needs confirm: true). Schedules use the agent's time zone, which is UTC unless it was set with update_agent; a new task without interval runs Mondays at 10:00. Every scheduled run spends the agent's credits, so confirm the schedule with the user. Entries from the agent's template, cs-approval-policy and the scheduled tasks its skills brought cannot be deleted or renamed: set enabled false instead. Turning off cs-approval-policy or changing its text also needs confirm: true: off, or a text that allows it, lets the agent act on outside services by itself without waiting for the user's yes. A running agent restarts for a new entry, a schedule change, turning one on or off, a rename, a delete or a revert; a text or description edit usually reaches it without a restart, and the result says which happened. get_my_agent lists the current entries. Registry skills are switched with apply_agent_skills instead. On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it; other team members read each entry in full with get_my_agent (entry). The agents playbook (get_playbook) covers custom skills and schedules.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

confirm.description: delete, revert and an upsert that turns off cs-approval-policy or changes its text: true to do it after the user agreed. Without it they only describe what would happen.

description.description: upsert or rename: a short summary the agent uses to pick the skill. Fixed for entries that come with the agent.

enabled.description: upsert: true to turn it on, false to turn it off. New entries start on.

interval.description: upsert, scheduled tasks only: a 5-field cron expression such as "0 9 * * 1-5" (weekdays 09:00). Omit to keep the current schedule, or Mondays 10:00 for a new task.

key.description: The entry's key: a full key (cs-... or cs-cron-...) or a bare slug such as "weekly-report" (lowercase letters, digits, single dashes). A bare slug names the agent's existing entry of that name, whichever kind it is.

kind.description: skill (instructions, cs-) or scheduled_task (runs on a schedule, cs-cron-). Decides the prefix of a bare key; without it a new bare key becomes a custom skill unless interval is given.

limit.description: history: how many versions to return, newest first (default 20).

new_key.description: rename: the new key, of the same kind.

source.description: revert: preset (the template default) or history (an earlier version).

value.description: upsert: the instructions (custom skill) or the prompt to run (scheduled task). Required when creating.

version_id.description: revert with source history: a versionId from action history.

name: manage_agent_custom_skill

notWritten.description: The starter task whose text was never written. It does not run, even when it shows on, until its text is saved.

restarting.description: upsert: whether this save restarts the agent, as Wiro answers it. false also covers a text edit that reaches a running agent without a restart.

title: Manage custom skills and scheduled tasks
